title: LongDPO: Unlock Better Long-form Generation Abilities for LLMs via Critique-augmented Stepwise Information
authors_zh: Bowen Ping, Jiali Zeng, Fandong Meng, Shuo Wang, Jie Zhou, Shanghang Zhang（北京大学、腾讯微信 AI、清华大学）
paper_type_zh: 逐步偏好数据构造与长文本对齐研究
best_for_zh: 适合构建长文本生成对齐流程、而完整答案偏好无法定位事实或结构失败位置的读者。
one_line: LongDPO uses MCTS, factual memory, and external critiques to build stepwise preference pairs for fine-grained long-form DPO.
LongDPO 用蒙特卡洛树搜索、事实记忆和外部批评构造逐步偏好回答对，供细粒度长文本 DPO 使用。
why: It turns long-form training from an outcome-only preference problem into a sequence of selected and refined local decisions.
inclusion_reason: It constructs, filters, refines, and consumes stepwise preference pairs so long-form DPO learns from localized quality and factual-consistency decisions rather than only terminal outputs.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Whole-answer preference learning gives one label to a long document even when its defects occur at a particular paragraph or transition. Long generations amplify factual contradiction, missing constraints, and local incoherence, while a terminal reward rarely says where the failure began. Selecting only a highest-reward final response can therefore hide poor intermediate decisions inside an apparently acceptable answer.

LongDPO asks how long-form preference data can expose and repair those local decisions before optimization. It replaces one outcome-level pair with multiple step-level pairs, each conditioned on the already selected prefix. The intervention is in how records are constructed and consumed for training, not merely in how long outputs are decoded.

完整答案的偏好学习会给一篇长文档一个标签，即使缺陷发生在某个段落或转折处。长文本会放大事实矛盾、遗漏约束和局部不连贯，而终局奖励很少说明失败从哪里开始。仅选择最终奖励最高的回答，因而可能把糟糕的中间决策隐藏在表面可接受的答案中。

LongDPO 询问如何让长文本偏好数据在优化之前暴露并修复这些局部决策。它把一个结果级回答对替换为多个步骤级回答对，每个回答对都以已选前缀为条件。干预发生在训练记录如何构造和消费，而不仅是长输出如何解码。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
LongDPO searches a tree of possible next writing steps instead of sampling complete documents once. A global memory pool stores verified facts from earlier selected steps and screens new candidates for contradiction. At each layer, the best consistent sibling becomes the chosen step and a random sibling becomes the rejected step, turning local alternatives into preference supervision.

Some selected steps are still low quality. For those below a reward threshold, an external critic compares the chosen step with a stronger sibling under the relevant writing principle and produces improvement suggestions. The generator rewrites the selected step using up to three high-confidence suggestions. Stepwise DPO then trains on these localized, consistency-aware pairs while ordinary DPO consumes the accompanying UltraFeedback examples.

LongDPO 搜索可能的下一写作步骤树，而不是一次采样完整文档。全局记忆池保存从先前已选步骤中验证的事实，并筛查新候选是否矛盾。在每一层中，最好的且一致的同级节点成为优选步骤，随机同级节点成为劣选步骤，从而把局部替代方案变成偏好监督。

部分已选步骤仍然质量较低。对于低于奖励阈值的步骤，外部批评器会在相关写作原则下将优选步骤与更强的同级节点比较，并提出改进建议。生成器使用至多三条高置信度建议重写已选步骤。随后，逐步 DPO 在这些局部且一致性敏感的回答对上训练，而普通 DPO 消费随附的 UltraFeedback 示例。

title: Method
方法
html:
For 2,500 WildChat instructions, the authors run MCTS to depth four, sample four child nodes per expansion, and score each node with a seven-principle reward from Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct. Before expansion, candidate content is divided into 128-word chunks and checked against earlier factual memory using gte-Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct retrieval and an LLM consistency decision. The highest-reward consistent node is selected; a random sibling supplies the negative step.

Chosen steps with reward at most 2.5 are paired with a better sibling to obtain principle-specific external critiques. The revised step conditions on the query, prior selected steps, and up to three writing suggestions. Training applies the DPO loss to each chosen-rejected next step given its prefix, combines the collected pairs with UltraFeedback, packs sequences to 32,768 tokens, and trains 250 steps using LongWriter-Llama 3.1-8B or LongWriter-Qwen 2.5-7B-Instruct.

对于 2,500 条 WildChat 指令，作者运行深度为四的蒙特卡洛树搜索，每次扩展采样四个子节点，并用 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 的七原则奖励给每个节点评分。扩展之前，候选内容被分成 128 词片段，并通过 gte-Qwen2-1.5B-Instruct 检索和大模型一致性判断，与较早的事实记忆进行核查。最高奖励且一致的节点被选中；随机同级节点提供负向步骤。

奖励不高于 2.5 的优选步骤会与更好的同级节点配对，以获得针对原则的外部批评。修订步骤以查询、先前选中的步骤和至多三条写作建议为条件。训练对给定前缀的每个优选—劣选下一步骤应用 DPO 损失，将收集的回答对与 UltraFeedback 合并，把序列打包至 32,768 词元，并用 LongWriter-Llama 3.1-8B 或 LongWriter-Qwen 2.5-7B-Instruct 训练 250 步。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
On LongBench-Write-en, LongWriter-Llama with LongDPO raises the average length score from 83.12 to 87.38 and quality score from 85.10 to 88.28; its ordinary-DPO counterpart reaches 85.55 and 85.66. For outputs above 4,000 words, the reported length score rises from 80.80 to 88.25. On LongGenBench, the Llama completion rate at 32K is 68.35 with LongDPO versus 65.24 with ordinary DPO, and the Qwen model reaches 84.95 versus 82.23.

The general-task comparison does not show the same degradation seen in some ordinary-DPO results. For LongWriter-Llama, LongDPO reports TruthfulQA 40.76, MMLU 58.78, and GSM8K 61.30, above the listed base model and DPO variants. Critique ablations favor external over self-critique on the reported averages, and the memory-pool experiment improves the average LLM-AggreFact score from 72.30 without memory to 73.67 with it. Human judges also prefer LongDPO outputs on diversity, consistency, and informativeness.

在 LongBench-Write-en 上，采用 LongDPO 的 LongWriter-Llama 将平均长度分数从 83.12 提升到 87.38，将质量分数从 85.10 提升到 88.28；其普通 DPO 对应项达到 85.55 和 85.66。对于超过 4,000 词的输出，报告的长度分数从 80.80 上升到 88.25。在 LongGenBench 上，Llama 在 32K 的完成率采用 LongDPO 为 68.35，普通 DPO 为 65.24；Qwen 模型分别为 84.95 和 82.23。

通用任务比较没有显示部分普通 DPO 结果中的同等退化。对 LongWriter-Llama，LongDPO 报告 TruthfulQA 为 40.76、MMLU 为 58.78、GSM8K 为 61.30，均高于列出的基础模型和 DPO 变体。批评消融在报告的平均值上偏向外部批评而非自我批评，记忆池实验也把 LLM-AggreFact 平均分从无记忆的 72.30 提升到有记忆的 73.67。人工评判者同样在多样性、一致性和信息性上更偏好 LongDPO 输出。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Existing long-form DPO commonly compares complete responses, even though factual and structural mistakes are often localized. LongDPO moves the pair-construction decision into a tree at each writing step. It joins reward-based selection to a persistent factual-memory check, so a high local reward is insufficient when the candidate contradicts previously accepted content.

The critique stage is also selective rather than universal: only low-reward chosen steps are refined, and the critic grounds suggestions in a better sibling and a specific writing principle. This combines search, data filtering, targeted revision, and a prefix-conditioned DPO objective into one data-to-training pipeline. The novelty is the control of local training records, not simply the use of MCTS or critique by itself.

现有长文本 DPO 通常比较完整回答，尽管事实和结构错误往往是局部的。LongDPO 把构造回答对的决策放进每个写作步骤的树中。它将基于奖励的选择与持续的事实记忆核查结合，因此当候选内容与先前接受的内容矛盾时，较高的局部奖励并不足够。

批评阶段也具有选择性而非普遍性：只有低奖励的优选步骤才会被修订，批评器把建议锚定在更好的同级节点和特定写作原则上。这样把搜索、数据过滤、定向修订和以前缀为条件的 DPO 目标结合为一个数据到训练的流程。新意在于控制局部训练记录，而不只是单独使用蒙特卡洛树搜索或批评。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The authors validate outputs up to 32K length and explicitly note that current benchmarks make longer generations hard to assess. Quality rewards for creative writing have no ground truth and depend on seven designed principles plus an external LLM, so the construction rule can encode evaluator bias. The pipeline is materially more expensive than terminal DPO because it uses tree expansion, reward scoring, fact extraction, retrieval, consistency checking, and critiques; it also reports no standalone release of the generated stepwise pairs.
作者验证的输出长度至多为 32K，并明确指出当前基准使更长生成难以评估。创意写作的质量奖励没有标准答案，依赖七项设计原则和外部大模型，因此构造规则可能编码评估器偏见。该流程比终局 DPO 显著昂贵，因为它使用树扩展、奖励评分、事实提取、检索、一致性检查和批评；论文也没有报告单独发布生成的逐步回答对。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use LongDPO when a long-form system needs an auditable path from a local writing decision to a training pair, particularly where consistency across sections matters. Its memory check and targeted critiques provide concrete insertion points for domain facts or editorial principles. It is less suitable for teams with a small inference budget or a task with an exact terminal verifier, where simpler rollouts and rule-based rewards may provide cheaper supervision than a large external critic.
当长文本系统需要从局部写作决策到训练回答对的可审计路径，尤其是章节间一致性很重要时，可使用 LongDPO。其记忆核查和定向批评为领域事实或编辑原则提供了具体的插入位置。对于推理预算较小的团队，或拥有精确终局验证器的任务，它不太适合；在这些情形中，较简单的采样和基于规则的奖励可能比大型外部批评器提供更廉价的监督。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Start with Figure 2 and Section 3.1: the important record is a next-step pair conditioned on a selected prefix, not a complete document. Then read the memory-pool and critique rules before Equation 9, because they determine what enters training. Tables 1–5 separate the value of stepwise DPO, external critique, and factual memory. Treat the long-form gains alongside the stated reward uncertainty and 32K evaluation ceiling rather than assuming the seven-principle evaluator is a complete measure of writing quality.
从图 2 和第 3.1 节开始：重要记录是以已选前缀为条件的下一步骤回答对，而不是完整文档。随后在公式 9 之前阅读记忆池和批评规则，因为它们决定什么进入训练。表 1 至表 5 分别揭示逐步 DPO、外部批评和事实记忆的价值。应将长文本收益与作者声明的奖励不确定性和 32K 评测上限一起看待，而不要假定七原则评估器已经完整衡量写作质量。
